snippet.title: I Secretly Lived In A Zoo!
snippet.description:
Today i Zhong Secretly Lived In @JayPrehistoricPetsTV Zoo!
I found out there’s an animal thief at my favorite zoo, and all the animals are going missing—including a giant yellow snake, alligators, and so many more! Because of that, security is now extra tight, so I’ll have to sneak in and build my very own secret room at the zoo to catch the thief. But it won’t be easy! Will I be able to catch the thief and save the zoo? Watch and see!

snippet.title: I Tested 100 BANNED Viral Toys In School!
snippet.description: Today I, Zhong, survive the world’s strictest school by using banned school products to help me cheat in class! I challenged my friends and myself to see if it’s possible to survive the whole day without being sent to detention. I’ll be using AI products like a giant squishy dumpling with a hidden iPhone 18 Pro Max inside of it to complete the hardest math quizzes, surviving lunch by using a secret snack box, and doing so much more! Hopefully, these banned viral toys will help me stay away from detention and survive till the end!

I’ll be hiding in a secret room at the school and setting up the craziest pranks to make all three teachers QUIT before the end of the day! I’ll be scaring them with science experiments, viral toys, banned snakes, and so much more! Hopefully, I’ll be able to save my cousin!
